% Author rendering must not consume the ordinary document footnote counter.
\documentclass[nominted]{pt-article}
\title{Footnote Counter Contract}
\addauthor{Primera}{Autora}{primera@example.com}{First Affiliation}
\addauthor{Segundo}{Autor}{segundo@example.com}{Second Affiliation}

\begin{document}
Text with the first ordinary footnote\footnote{PTARTICLEFIRSTFOOTNOTE}.
\makeatletter
\typeout{PT-TEST-FOOTNOTE=\arabic{footnote}}
\makeatother
\end{document}
